spell.lne_paladins.sirens_tears.name: Siren´s Tears
spell.lne_paladins.sirens_tears.descript: Healing spells have a {trigger_chance} chance to remove a harmful effect and giving the regeneration effect.
spell.lne_paladins.holy_weapon.name: Holy Weapon
spell.lne_paladins.holy_weapon.descripti: Enhances your next melee hits with {damage} healing spell damage, heals the caster for {heal} hearts.
effect.lne_paladins.holy_weapon.descript: Enhances your melee hits heal with additional healing power damage, 100% crit chance against undead.
spell.lne_paladins.holy_prevention.name: Prevention
spell.lne_paladins.holy_prevention.descr: Invisible healing shield for {effect_duration} seconds, that activates when you fall below 20%% of your max health.
effect.lne_paladins.holy_prevention.desc: Heals you when you fall below 20% max health, the heal amount enhances with effect amplifier. If you´re already under 20% when the effect is applied, the healing is reduced.
